Audit doc: docs/design/gap-audit-2026-11-03.md, section(s) "Knowledge" (gap table rows and the "KN-D" entry in "Filed fix tasks").
Current screenshots (captured 2026-11-03 from `vite --mode mock`; the live stack was down; shim captures are labelled AUDIT FIXTURE):
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-d.jpg, knowledge-m.jpg (baseline)
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-default-d.jpg, knowledge-default-m.jpg (`/knowledge`, stuck on "Loading projects...")
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-projects-d.jpg (with `projects.read` injected: the project choice works)
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-list-d.jpg, knowledge-list-t.jpg, knowledge-list-m.jpg (`?scope=project:…0001`)
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-doc-d.jpg, knowledge-doc-t.jpg, knowledge-doc-m.jpg (`/knowledge/…0005?scope=…`)
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-history-d.jpg, knowledge-history-m.jpg, knowledge-details-d.jpg, knowledge-details-m.jpg
  docs/evidence/gap-audit-2026-11-03/knowledge-empty-d.jpg, knowledge-empty-m.jpg, knowledge-failed-d.jpg, knowledge-failed-m.jpg

Scope, expected result and acceptance (from the audit):

**K-D. Knowledge: document Sources / Linked work row, verification and tab semantics**
- type: feature. class: standard-high. estimate: 3h.
- files: `src/features/knowledge/KnowledgeDocument.tsx` (Sources, verification, tabs, footer), `src/features/knowledge/HumanNodeWorkspace.module.css`.
- Expected result:
  - Below Verification, a 2-column row (stacked at ≤900px):
    - "Sources (n)": each source is a doc icon, title link plus revision/date, and a right typed action label from the provenance kind. Any raw JSON goes behind a "Technical reference" details element with `<code>` that is not visible by default.
    - "Linked work": the panel shows "Linked work is not offered by this read contract." until edges exist.
  - Verification shows "Recorded by X · <date> · applies to revision N" and "Next review: <date>" when present, plus "Valid until <date>" when `valid_until` is set.
  - Tabs use `role=tablist`/`tab`/`tabpanel` with `aria-selected`. Counts are pill badges. On phone, an overflow gradient hints at more tabs.
  - Footer: "Current revision N · Older revisions remain available" (or pinned copy).
- Acceptance: screenshots at 1440 (side-by-side boxes, y within 4px) and 390 (stacked), plus axe clean. Playwright assertions:
  - `getByRole('tab',{name:/Sources/})` exists.
  - `getByRole('region',{name:/Linked work/})` is visible.
  - Given a fixture with provenance, `getByText(/"kind"/)` is not visible.

General acceptance for this task:
- Follow AGENTS.md and docs/design/visual-acceptance.md: preserve the mock's hierarchy, pane proportions, typography, density and primary controls; use existing shared tokens/components; render only real or explicitly labelled fixture facts.
- Add a targeted Playwright check at 1440x900 and 390x844 (mock mode) asserting the expected result above, plus @axe-core/playwright with no violations on the touched page. Attach the before/after desktop and phone screenshots to the close summary and name any remaining differences.
- Velocity rules: run only the targeted tests you add or touch; no full suites, no slow tests.
- Shared shell, route, capability, mock-handler and component changes: coordinate with the integration owner and keep edits to the files listed above.

Scope, expected result and acceptance (from the audit):

**S-A. Settings: consistent panels, title rhythm and technical identity disclosure**
- type: bugfix. class: standard-medium. estimate: 3h.
- files: `src/features/settings/index.tsx`, `src/features/settings/FrameworkStatus.tsx`, `src/features/settings/ProjectBindings.tsx`, `src/features/settings/ProjectBindings.module.css`, and a new `src/features/settings/Settings.module.css`.
- Expected result:
  - The H1 "Settings" has a one-line subtitle, then a grid of `Panel`s: Identity, Framework connection, Your notifications and Project execution bindings. Two columns at ≥1200px, one column ≤1199px, gaps `var(--space-4)`–`var(--space-6)`.
  - Panel titles use the Panel title style, never page-title size. On phone no H2 is larger than the H1.
  - Identity uses `DetailList`: "Signed in as: Sample Owner". "AQ version 0.0.0-fixture" sits inside `<details><summary>Technical identity</summary>`.
  - Framework connection shows a daemon status dot plus label, and Worker nodes as a sub-heading inside the panel. Unavailable/loading lines use the shared meta/QueryStatus style.
  - `src/features/notifications/Notifications.tsx` is NOT changed. It is already a Panel.
- Acceptance: screenshots at 1440 and 390 (full page), plus axe clean. Playwright assertions:
  - `page.locator('main section[class*=panel]')` count is at least 4.
  - `getByText('0.0.0-fixture')` is hidden until `getByText('Technical identity').click()`.
  - At 390, the H1's font-size is greater than each H2's font-size (computed style).
  - At 390, `getByRole('heading',{name:'Identity'}).boundingBox().y - h1.bottom` is at least 16.
